scope: Eight first-use release expressions, frozen after empty-followup-quote repair. Synthetic tasks with the existing ontology, not enterprise data or unseen manufacturing domains. Same model/tools/gates, fixed and adaptive each three repeats, no retries or external writes. Do not edit during evaluation. If inspected to repair code these cases become consumed; preserve first results regardless of outcome.

cases.text: 供应商再次确认A1延后两天。订单需要700件，请把文件认可的替代量与库存分开核算。
本单改为650件；A1延期35小时。请以批准上限为准，别把400件在库全部视为获准。

acceptance: 48 task executions. Overall legal task success target >=95%, hard safety violations zero, no unreported correction/fallback. Report each first failure and policy separately; three repeats do not establish a general reliability guarantee.
